profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack, Platform, UI
profile.summary:
Full stack web developer, more frontend than backend, with a passion for making accessible web applications.

Experience developing with Javascript, React, AngularJS, jQuery, Java, Node, and a little Python.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Architected user-facing and platform solutions in React, Node.js, and Java, designing scalable APIs backed by MariaDB/MySQL, GraphQL, and AI tooling for high-volume enterprise systems.
* Owned end-to-end system design for critical services, driving architecture, API design, scalability, performance, reliability, and long-term evolution.
* Owned core component libraries and shared design-system infrastructure used across the platform, ensuring performance, consistency, accessibility, and maintainability.
* Designed and implemented APIs supporting complex product workflows and enterprise integrations.
* Built and optimized backend services with careful attention to scalability, performance characteristics, and database efficiency in large-scale SaaS environments.
* Recognized expert in WCAG and web accessibility, leading implementation and remediation across React systems, legacy UIs, and shared design-system components to improve usability and inclusive experiences while influencing platform-wide engineering standards.
* Frequently partnered directly with customers to resolve technical issues, gather product feedback, and inform roadmap and architectural decisions.
* Mentored engineers and QEs, built technical training programs, led Agile delivery, and operated in technical project and product leadership roles.
* Served as project and team development lead for cross-functional initiatives, collaborating closely with engineering, design, and product stakeholders.
* Led and contributed to company-wide engineering initiatives improving platform consistency, performance, and development practices.
* Awarded multiple internal and industry recognitions for technical excellence and impact
* Inventor with two patents pending.

positions.title: Web UI Developer Intern
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description: Front end and UI development using AngularJS attached to a Java backend.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description: Technical founder for an ambitious food delivery college startup. Designed and developed a Node.js ordering system for food deliveries. Database in Postgres, frontend in bootstrap and AngularJS.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description: Software development for web performance testing. Utilizes Java, Python, and Django to drive Javascript based test scripts simulating thousands of real users simultaneously powered by Amazon EC2. Managed by Jira, version controlled with git and mercurial, and deployed by Bamboo. An incomplete list of technologies I've used here include: Python, Django, Flask, Java, JSP, EC2, Javascript, AngularJS, MongoDB, MySQL.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software development for a medical application for the Global Public Health division of UCSD's Department of Medicine. XML, Android, JSP, AJAX, Python, Django, MySQL, SQlite.

Developed documentation, hosted webinar for software training, and managed data personally for dozens of clients.

positions.title: Web Developer - Python, Django
positions.description: Developed, tested, and refactored the backend code for a HIIT-exercise social network using Python and Django.

positions.title: Founder, Lead Technician
positions.description: Operation Reboot is a volunteer organization dedicated to providing computer access to the disadvantaged students attending Irvine Valley College. Operation Reboot technicians work on donated computers to fix and rebuild them for the educational/career use of single mothers and other disadvantaged students who cannot afford a computer for school.

projects.title: TEDxDelMar Program
projects.description: I organized a TEDx conference that hosted over 12 speakers. Topics included the future of human technology, culture, interpersonal relationships, well-being, transportation, and much more.
